the plasmonic Purcell effect is an effective way to enhance spontaneous emission rates of quantum wells, which can be further improved by nanostructuring hyperbolic metamaterias.

nanopatterning of hyperbolic metameterial (HMM) layers leads to a broadband enhancement of the emission intensity and the recombination rate in InGaN quantum well (QWs).
